info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v4-spec
info.description: This API provides real-time status updates for auto insurance quotes to facilitate user decision-making. It allows consumers to check the progression and availability of their submitted quotes seamlessly. Typical users include insurance agents and platforms integrating insurance services to enhance customer experience. The straightforward GET operation ensures that users can quickly access and monitor the status of their quotes without excessive complexity.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the current status of quotes in the system. You can use this information to determine if a quote is pending, approved, or rejected.
